entities.summary: Masahiko Shibayama  is a Japanese politician. He is a member of the House of Representatives belonging to the Liberal Democratic Party, Deputy Secretary-General of the Liberal Democratic Party and Chairman of the Federation of Saitama Prefecture Liberal Democratic Party. He served as Minister of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology from October 2018 to September 2019.
